2607.00572.title: HARC: Coupling Harmfulness and Refusal Directions for Robust Safety Alignment
2607.00572.paper_summary: Understanding how aligned LLMs internally represent safety is critical for diagnosing alignment vulnerabilities, as it explains why jailbreaks succeed and informs the design of robust alignment strategies. Prior work shows that aligned LLMs encode harmfulness and refusal as separable directions in the residual stream at prompt-side token positions. We show that jailbreaks succeed at prompt encoding by suppressing either the refusal or harmfulness direction before any token is generated, with distinct attack classes occupying separable regions of the harmfulness-refusal plane. Extending the analysis to response-token positions, we find that the model recognizes harmful content while it is generating that content, even when it failed to recognize the input as harmful at the prompt side. Motivated by our findings, we introduce HARC (Harmfulness-And-Refusal Coupling), a fine-tuning method that pairs the two directions across both prompt and response positions. Since the intervention is confined to the harmfulness-refusal subspace, it leaves the rest of the residual stream intact and does not degrade general capability or inflate over-refusal. Across extensive experiments, HARC achieves the strongest robustness-capability-usability trade-off among six baselines spanning the major training-time and inference-time safety methods. The harmfulness and refusal directions at prompt and response positions transfer across the five model families and two scales we tested without architecture-specific tuning.
2607.00572.paper_summary_zh: 理解對齊的 LLM 如何在內部表示安全性對於診斷對齊脆弱性至關重要，因為這解釋了為什麼越獄攻擊會成功並為設計穩健的對齊策略提供了信息。先前的研究顯示，對齊的 LLM 在提示端的標記位置將有害性和拒絕編碼為可分離的方向。我們展示了越獄攻擊如何通過在生成任何標記之前抑制拒絕或有害性方向來成功進行，並且不同的攻擊類別佔據了有害性-拒絕平面中的可分離區域。將分析擴展到回應標記位置，我們發現模型在生成有害內容時能夠識別該內容，即使它在提示端未能將輸入識別為有害。受到我們發現的啟發，我們引入了 HARC（有害性與拒絕耦合），這是一種微調方法，將兩個方向配對於提示和回應位置。由於干預僅限於有害性-拒絕子空間，因此它保持了其餘殘差流的完整性，並不會降低一般能力或增加過度拒絕。在廣泛的實驗中，HARC 在六個基準之間實現了最強的穩健性-能力-可用性權衡，這些基準涵蓋了主要的訓練時間和推理時間安全方法。提示和回應位置的有害性和拒絕方向在我們測試的五個模型系列和兩個規模之間轉移，而無需特定於架構的調整。
